# Theming

Modes and brands.

Brand expressive has **2 modes** and **1 brand**. A mode swaps the colours; corners and type stay the same in every mode.

## The five answers

| Question | Answer | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| What can a theme change? | Mode only | One brand, so only the mode changes. |
| How many themes ship? | Two | Light and dark. |
| How are brands handled? | One brand | One brand per campaign. |
| Which modes ship? | Light and dark | Light and dark ship as standard. |
| What changes when the theme changes? | Colors only | Only colors change. |

## Where it lands

- Button
- Card
- Overlay

## When to use what

| Situation | Use | Not | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Someone switches to dark | The dark semantic mode | A separate campaign palette | Dark ships as standard; campaigns change values, not structure. |
